title: IRQ source-to-interface map
scope: How the 13 serviced channels travel from SoC peripheral IRQ outputs through the subsystem ports, the core gateway and arbiter, to trap commit. Static wiring only: it does not show peripheral register clearing, firmware, nesting, or any executed interrupt.

baseline.repo: RISCFORGE_1TOPS-main/rtl worktree; subsystem, core IRQ RTL and the five peripheral IRQ sources combined

nodes.label: Peripheral IRQ outputs: Timer 0, Timer 1, UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO
nodes.note: Also timer0 at line 1097, UART at 1119, GPIO at 1153, SPI events at 1180, timer1 at 1220.

nodes.label: subsystem fast_irq_i[15:0] / timer_irq_i
nodes.note: timer_irq_i takes timer0_irq_o[1] at line 1293; only fast_irq_i[11:0] are serviced.

nodes.label: irq_gateway: edge latch for GPIO, event latch for timers/SPI, level pass-through for I2C/UART
nodes.note: Modes are constants: edge_mode 13'h0002 and event_mode 13'h1fe9 at top.v:213-214.

nodes.label: irq_arbiter: class 2 fixed order, class 1 and 0 round robin, mintprio gate
execute_cycle accepts the interrupt on a valid EX item
WB commit: trap entry, one-hot gateway clear, round-robin advance
mip[11] MEIP and mip[3] MSIP bits (ext_irq_i, sw_irq_i tied to 0)
nodes.note: sw_irq_i tied to 1'b0 at line 1295. Both reach mip through csr_regfile.v:217 only.

nodes.label: PLIC
nodes.note: Searched riscforge_soc_subsystem.sv: no PLIC instance and no plic port; MEIP is driven by the constant 1'b0 at line 1294, and irq_arbiter.v:20 masks only mie[27:16] and mie[7].

nodes.label: CLIC
nodes.note: ips/clic-master/ exists as standalone RTL. Searched riscforge_soc_subsystem.sv for a clic instance and csr_regfile.v for mintstatus/mtvt/mnxti; none found.

edges.label: tagged trap packet through EX/MEM and MEM/WB
wb_commit_irq advances the matching round-robin pointer
no delivery path: arbiter masks only mie[27:16], mie[7]

unknowns: Peripheral internal clear and re-arm timing is documented from the peripheral RTL but is not drawn here.
Firmware handlers, nesting protocol and interrupt latency are outside this map.
G3.6 timer-to-handler integration and G6 end-to-end behavior are not established by this wiring.
